brief:
Israeli opposition parties have reached coalition understandings that sketch the outlines of a possible government led by Gadi Eisenkot to succeed Benjamin Netanyahu, Shehab Wire reported. The arrangement would bring sweeping changes across key ministries including defense, internal security, foreign affairs, justice, finance, and education.

The coalition negotiations reflect ongoing political maneuvering among Israel's opposition blocs as they position themselves for potential power transfer, with the defense and security portfolios emerging as central points in the proposed ministerial distribution.

title: Israeli opposition parties outline potential government under Eisenkot
